sneak--verb.def: To go somewhere quietly so nobody notices.
sneak--verb.ex: He sneaked out through the back door.

shell--verb.def: To attack a place with large guns.
shell--verb.ex: The town was shelled for days.

testify--verb.def: To give evidence in a court of law.

walker--noun.def: A person who walks, especially for pleasure.
walker--noun.ex: The path is popular with walkers.

pin--noun.def: A short thin piece of metal with a sharp point.
pin--noun.ex: Hold the cloth with a pin.

obey--verb.def: To do what a rule or a person tells you.

powder--verb.def: To cover something with a fine dry substance.

bum--noun.def: An informal word for a person with no home or job.
bum--noun.ex: He lived like a bum for a year.

blade--noun.def: The flat cutting part of a knife, or a thin flat part that turns.

widow--noun.def: A woman whose husband has died.

moral--adj.def: Relating to what is right and wrong in behaviour.

grief--noun.def: Very deep sadness, especially after a death.
grief--noun.ex: Grief kept her at home for months.

core--noun.def: The central or most important part of something.
core--noun.ex: Honesty is the core of her argument.

jam--verb.def: To push something into a tight space, or to block a machine.

goat--noun.def: A farm animal with horns that climbs well.
goat--noun.ex: A goat stood on the wall.

whiskey--noun.def: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain.
whiskey--noun.ex: He poured a glass of whiskey.

resistance--noun.def: Refusal to accept something, or the power to oppose it.

attached--adj.def: Joined to something, or feeling fond of someone.
attached--adj.ex: The note was attached to the door.

naughty--adj.def: Behaving badly, usually said of children.
naughty--adj.ex: The naughty boy hid the keys.

tap--verb.def: To hit something lightly and quickly.
tap--verb.ex: She tapped the glass with a spoon.

prick--noun.def: A small sharp pain from a point.
prick--noun.ex: He felt a prick in his arm.

nicely--adv.def: In a pleasant or satisfactory way.

nerves--noun.def: A nervous feeling before an important event.

abuse--noun.def: Cruel treatment of someone, or wrong use of something.
abuse--noun.ex: The report describes abuse of power.

bend--noun.def: A curve in a road or a river.

review--verb.def: To examine something again, or to write an opinion of it.

salary--noun.def: The money paid monthly for a professional job.

profit--noun.def: The money you gain after costs are paid.
profit--noun.ex: The shop made a small profit.

colleague--noun.exTr: Bir iş arkadaşım beni eve bıraktı.

insult--noun.def: A rude remark that offends someone.
insult--noun.ex: His reply was a clear insult.

insult--verb.def: To say something rude that offends someone.

appeal--verb.def: To ask a higher court to change a decision, or to make a public request.

testimony--noun.def: A formal statement given in court.

praise--verb.def: To say that someone or something is very good.

commission--noun.def: A payment for selling something, or an official group.

fraud--noun.def: The crime of deceiving people to get money.

stroke--noun.def: A sudden illness in the brain, or a single movement of the arm.
stroke--noun.ex: He had a stroke last winter.

stroke--verb.def: To move your hand gently over a surface.

ambassador--noun.def: The chief official who represents a country abroad.

cable--noun.def: A thick wire that carries electricity or holds weight.
cable--noun.ex: A cable runs under the sea.

buzz--noun.def: A low continuous sound like a bee.
buzz--noun.ex: A buzz came from the old fridge.

buzz--verb.def: To make a low continuous sound.

musical--noun.def: A play or a film with a lot of singing.
musical--noun.ex: We saw a musical in London.

slide--verb.def: To move smoothly over a surface.

ultimate--adj.def: Final, or the best or greatest of its kind.

payment--noun.def: An amount of money paid, or the act of paying.
payment--noun.ex: The first payment is due Monday.

paperwork--noun.def: The written work of forms and records.

squeeze--verb.def: To press something firmly, especially with your hand.
squeeze--verb.ex: Squeeze the lemon over the fish.

madness--noun.def: Very foolish behaviour, or the state of being mentally ill.
madness--noun.ex: Driving in that fog was madness.

burden--verb.def: To give someone a heavy duty or worry.
burden--verb.ex: I will not burden you with details.

mount--verb.def: To increase steadily, or to fix something in place.

pound--verb.def: To hit something repeatedly and hard.
pound--verb.ex: His heart pounded after the climb.
pound--verb.exTr: Tırmanıştan sonra kalbi güm güm attı.

lap--noun.def: The top of your legs when sitting, or one circuit of a track.
lap--noun.ex: The cat slept on her lap.

rub--verb.def: To move your hand or a cloth over a surface with pressure.
rub--verb.ex: Rub the cream into your hands.

soil--noun.def: The top layer of earth in which plants grow.
soil--noun.ex: The soil here is rich and dark.

sail--verb.def: To travel on water in a boat.
sail--verb.ex: They sailed to Cyprus in June.

badge--noun.def: A small sign worn to show who you are.

polish--noun.def: A substance rubbed on a surface to make it shine.
polish--noun.ex: Put some polish on the shoes.

weed--noun.def: A wild plant growing where it is not wanted.
weed--noun.ex: Pull the weeds out by hand.

eagle--noun.def: A large bird of prey with very good sight.
eagle--noun.ex: An eagle circled above the cliff.
eagle--noun.exTr: Bir kartal uçurumun üstünde daireler çizdi.

barn--noun.def: A large farm building for animals or crops.
barn--noun.ex: The hay is stored in the barn.

budget--adj.def: Cheap and suitable for people with little money.
budget--adj.ex: We flew with a budget airline.

plot--noun.def: The story of a book or a film, or a small piece of land.
plot--noun.ex: The plot is hard to follow.

bothered--adj.ex: She was not bothered by the noise.

leak--noun.def: A hole that lets liquid or gas escape.
leak--noun.ex: There is a leak in the roof.

leak--verb.def: To let liquid escape, or to give out secret information.
leak--verb.ex: The pipe has been leaking for days.

patch--noun.def: A small piece of material used to cover a hole.
patch--noun.ex: She sewed a patch on the knee.

necessarily--adv.def: In every case, used mostly in negative sentences.
necessarily--adv.ex: Cheap does not necessarily mean bad.
necessarily--adv.exTr: Ucuz olması ille de kötü demek değil.

rocky--adj.def: Covered with rocks, or difficult and unstable.
rocky--adj.ex: The path is steep and rocky.

betray--verb.def: To harm someone who trusts you.

soviet--noun.def: A citizen of the former Soviet Union.

radar--noun.def: A system that finds objects using radio waves.

valentine--noun.def: A card sent to someone you love in February.
valentine--noun.exTr: Ona bir sevgililer günü kartı gönderdi.

counter--noun.def: A long flat surface where you are served in a shop.

sack--verb.def: To dismiss someone from a job, in British English.
